_about: Rebuild of the 16 Nov Ideas board (.github/workflows/board-rebuild.yml) with the board code that never drops his typed words (Krish, 2026-11-09: "Somehow, you've also managed to lose a bunch of my comments for that article"; "Yes, rebuild and publish the 16 Nov board"). The inputs are the Sunday ideas run's own (ideas.json, queue.json, combine.json, sources.json, as on claude/ideas-16-nov-run, PR #464); his saved picks, presses and words live on the board server and are untouched by a rebuild. 11 Nov: Tue 17 carries the proactive-AI short, finished and filed (Krish, 11 Nov 2026: "Schedule it for Tuesday off day instead"); its video is served from the library by sha256 (board-assets.json).
